text: 创业板指涨超1%，沪指跌0.03%，深成指涨0.33%，科创50涨近2.8%，半导体芯片、算力硬件、创新药等方向涨幅居前，沪深京三市上涨个股近3100只。
text_en: ChiNext Index rose over 1%, Shanghai Composite Index fell 0.03%, Shenzhen Component Index rose 0.33%, STAR 50 rose nearly 2.8%, with semiconductor chips, computing power hardware, innovative drugs and other sectors leading the gains; nearly 3,100 stocks advanced across the Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing markets.
